A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work and contain readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–G. Content can be reliably matched despite the expanded bibliography.

before.justification: v2 reports original prompting and fine-tuning experiments, dataset quality assessments, and supplementary analyses, including Tables 2–3 and 11–12.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and analyses in the main text and appendices; their retention still qualifies as original empirical results.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same CoRe procedure, extension-based training-data augmentation, and supervised fine-tuning objective. The actual prompts in Appendix D are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use GSM8K, E-GSM, MAWPS, SVAMP, and GSM-IC with the same task coverage. Newly listed benchmark references, such as UGPhysics and UGMathBench, are not evaluated.

E2.justification: The same PS, PS+, zero-shot CoT, and fine-tuning comparisons appear in Tables 2–3. The base and specialized model comparisons in Figure 5 and Tables 11–12 are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Dataset construction and filtering, evaluation metrics, sample sizes, model scales, training settings, decoding, and answer extraction remain unchanged in Sections 2 and 4 and Appendix B.

E4.justification: The reasoning analysis, length-based comparisons, training curves, scaling analyses, error analysis, and case studies are retained. Appendix F's GPT-4o-mini, GPT-4o, and o1 analyses already appear in v2.

E5.justification: The hypothesis tests in Section 2.1 and Appendix F and inter-annotator agreement reporting in Table 5 are unchanged. No repeated-run, seed, or uncertainty reporting is added.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted trends, and qualitative findings match throughout. For example, Table 2 retains GPT-3.5-turbo CoRe Acc4 of 69.76%; the appendix results in Tables 11–12 also match.

T1.justification: The CoLeG metric definitions, training objective, entailment-filtering equations, and statistical hypotheses and contrast formulation are unchanged. No mathematical correction, theorem, or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about long-context weaknesses, E-GSM, CoLeG metrics, CoRe, extension-based fine-tuning, and cross-benchmark generalization.

C2.justification: The working-memory motivation and interpretation that the methods improve reasoning more than semantic understanding are unchanged. Applicability discussions, case interpretations, and educational cautions in Appendix G are also retained.

D1.justification: Model identifiers, prompts, hyperparameters, hardware and computation costs, licenses, and code/data/model access information remain unchanged, including the detailed disclosures in Appendices A, B, and D.

R1.justification: v3 adds eleven bibliography entries, including Agent4Edu, LogicPro, Humanity's Last Exam, UGPhysics, and UGMathBench, without integrating them into the discussion. Existing works remain represented, and the substantive research positioning is unchanged.

P1.justification: Bibliographic publication details and corresponding author-year labels are updated, including ROSCOE from 2022 to 2023. The arXiv version/date changes, while scientific prose and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Expanded bibliography entries change line wrapping and page breaks, with slight spacing changes around Acknowledgments and References. Figures 1–11 and Tables 1–16 retain their designs, captions, and organization.

improvement.justification: v3 provides fuller publication metadata and additional bibliography entries, but the added works are not integrated into the argument. Methods, evidence, explanations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices, so these bibliographic edits produce no meaningful overall quality difference.
